grammar.title: Future perfect e future continuous per la roadmap; preposizioni di tempo
grammar.explanation: Una roadmap parla di due tipi di futuro. Future perfect (will have + participio passato): un'attività COMPLETATA entro una scadenza. Va quasi sempre con 'by': By Q2 we'll have migrated all the services. By the end of March the team will have finished testing. Future continuous (will be + -ing): un'attività IN CORSO in un momento o periodo futuro: In March we'll be testing with the partner bank. This time next month we'll be running both systems in parallel. Per piani già decisi usa anche be going to e il present continuous (We're going live on 3 June). Preposizioni di tempo: by = entro (scadenza), until / till = fino a (durata), in + mese/trimestre/anno (in March, in Q3), on + giorno/data (on 3 June), at + ora / at the end of, during / over + periodo (over the next six months), from … to (da … a; 'through' è americano). In presentazione: una milestone per frase, la scadenza ben chiara, e distingui ciò che sarà 'done' da ciò che sarà 'in progress'.

examples.en: By the end of Q2, we'll have migrated all the batch jobs to the cloud.
In March we'll be testing the new flow with the partner bank.
We'll be running both systems in parallel until the end of April.
The new onboarding goes live on 3 June.
Over the next six months, we'll be rolling out the app in three phases.
By then, the old platform will have been switched off.

grammar.italianTrap: Gli italiani confondono 'by' e 'until' (entrambi 'entro / fino a'): 'We'll finish until March' è sbagliato → 'We'll finish by March' (scadenza); 'until' solo per qualcosa che dura: 'We'll be testing until March'. Altri calchi: 'in the 3rd of June' → 'on 3 June'; 'within the end of Q2' → 'by the end of Q2'; 'We will migrate by Q2' va bene, ma 'By Q2 we'll have migrated' rende più chiaro che sarà già fatto.

phrases.en: Let me take you through the roadmap for the next twelve months.
phrases.it: Vi illustro la roadmap dei prossimi dodici mesi.

phrases.en: The plan is split into three phases.
phrases.it: Il piano è diviso in tre fasi.

phrases.en: By the end of Q1, we'll have completed the migration.
phrases.it: Entro fine Q1 avremo completato la migrazione.

phrases.en: In April we'll be testing with the partner bank.
phrases.it: Ad aprile saremo in fase di test con la banca partner.
Il go-live è previsto per il 3 giugno.

phrases.en: We'll run both systems in parallel until the end of the quarter.
phrases.it: Faremo girare i due sistemi in parallelo fino a fine trimestre.

phrases.en: This depends on the vendor delivering the API on time.
phrases.it: Questo dipende dalla consegna puntuale dell'API da parte del fornitore.

phrases.en: We're on track for the first milestone.
phrases.it: Siamo in linea con la prima milestone.

phrases.en: This item has slipped by about two weeks.
phrases.it: Questa attività è slittata di circa due settimane.

phrases.en: Further down the line, we're looking at real-time reconciliation.
phrases.it: Più avanti, stiamo valutando la riconciliazione in tempo reale.

quiz.q: 'By the end of Q2, we ___ all the services to the new cluster.'
quiz.why: 'By' + scadenza e azione completata: future perfect 'will have migrated'.

quiz.q: 'In March we ___ the new flow with the partner bank, so the test environment will be busy.'
quiz.why: Attività in corso durante un periodo futuro: future continuous.

quiz.q: 'We'll keep the old platform running ___ the end of April.'
quiz.why: Durata fino a un momento: 'until'. 'By' è per una scadenza.

quiz.q: Which sentence presents a deadline correctly?
options: We'll finish the integration until September.
We'll have finished the integration by September.
We'll have finished the integration until September.
We finish the integration within September end.
quiz.why: Scadenza + azione conclusa: 'will have finished by'. 'Until' indica durata.

quiz.q: 'This time next month, the team ___ in parallel with the old system.'
quiz.why: 'This time next month' = un momento futuro in cui l'azione è in corso: future continuous.

quiz.q: 'By the time the audit starts, the old servers ___.'
quiz.why: Azione conclusa prima di un momento futuro, con soggetto che la subisce: future perfect passivo.

quiz.q: '___ the next six months we'll be rolling out the app to all clients.'
quiz.why: 'Over' / 'during' + periodo per un'attività che si sviluppa nel tempo.

gapfill.text: By Q3 we'll ___ replaced the legacy reporting.
We'll be running both systems in parallel ___ the end of May.
In April the team will be ___ the integration with the custodian.

reorder.answer: By June we'll have migrated every service.
answers: We'll have migrated every service by June.

reorder.answer: In March we'll be testing with the bank.
answers: We'll be testing with the bank in March.

fluency.prompt: Roadmap slide: Q1 cloud migration completed; Q2 testing with the partner bank; go-live on 1 July. Present it to the management committee. 50 seconds.
fluency.model: Let me take you through the roadmap. By the end of Q1, we'll have migrated all the batch jobs to the cloud. In Q2 we'll be testing the new flow with the partner bank, so most of the team will be focused on that. Go-live is planned for 1 July. We'll run both systems in parallel until the end of the summer, just to be safe.
keyPhrases: Let me take you through the roadmap

fluency.prompt: The client asks: 'Where will you be with the new app in six months?' Answer using what will be done and what will be in progress. 40 seconds.
fluency.model: In six months, we'll have released the new app to all clients on all mobile platforms. By then, the old web portal will have been switched off. At that point we'll be working on the second phase, which is real-time notifications.

fluency.prompt: One milestone has slipped: the vendor is late with the API, so integration testing moves from May to June. Explain the impact on the timeline. 45 seconds.
fluency.model: I need to flag one change to the timeline. The vendor is late with the API, so integration testing has slipped by about four weeks. We'll be testing in June instead of May. However, we'll still have finished everything by the end of Q3, so the go-live date doesn't change.

write.prompt: Write the speaker notes (80-120 words) for a one-year roadmap slide for the digital onboarding: Q1 new identity check with the KYC provider, Q2 testing with the partner bank, go-live in July, Q4 decommission the old flow. Use at least one future perfect and one future continuous.
write.model: Let me take you through the roadmap for next year. The plan is split into four phases. By the end of Q1, we'll have integrated the new identity check with the KYC provider. In Q2 we'll be testing the full flow with the partner bank, including account opening and the first transfers. Go-live is planned for July. After that, we'll be running the old and new flows in parallel until October. By the end of Q4, the old flow will have been switched off completely. The main dependency is the partner bank's test environment, so we're agreeing dates with them now.
checklist: Almeno un future perfect con 'by' (ciò che sarà completato)
Almeno un future continuous (ciò che sarà in corso)
Preposizioni di tempo corrette (by / until / in / on)
Una dipendenza o un rischio sulla timeline
keyPhrases: Let me take you through the roadmap
